scripts.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && node scripts/python.mjs -m pip install -r backend/requirements.lock && node scripts/python.mjs -m pip install --no-deps -e backend -e apps/api -e apps/worker
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/python.mjs -m alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check backend apps scripts
scripts.typecheck:py: node scripts/python.mjs -m mypy backend/src apps/api/src apps/worker/src scripts/export_openapi.py scripts/benchmark_folders.py scripts/benchmark_cases.py scripts/evaluate_slack_parser.py scripts/evaluate_knowledge_retrieval.py scripts/evaluate_automatic_generation_quality.py scripts/export_automatic_generation_quality_snapshot.py scripts/evaluate_automatic_generation_version_regression.py scripts/verify_automatic_generation_quality_artifacts.py scripts/build_knowledge_golden_sample.py scripts/rebuild_knowledge_projection.py scripts/rehearse_lightrag_failover.py scripts/phase-f/uat_evidence.py scripts/phase-f/uat_quality_review_seed.py scripts/phase-f/lightrag_full_reindex.py scripts/phase-f/lightrag_full_reindex_disposable.py scripts/phase-f/load_profile.py scripts/phase-f/object_storage_recovery.py scripts/phase-f/migration_roundtrip_disposable.py
scripts.test:unit:py: node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest backend/tests/unit apps/api/tests apps/worker/tests scripts/tests scripts/phase-f/tests -m not\ postgres
scripts.test:phase-f: node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest scripts/phase-f/tests scripts/tests/test_phase_f_load_profile.py -m not\ postgres && node --test scripts/tests/phase-f-uat-browser-local.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:schema && pnpm test:adr && pnpm test:operations && pnpm openapi:check
